annotations.title: Delete a Reddit catalog, feed or product set

description: PERMANENTLY delete a Reddit catalog (with all its products, feeds and product sets), a product feed, or a product set. Unlike campaigns these really are deleted, and it cannot be undone. Call WITHOUT confirm first: nothing is deleted, and the answer lists what would go with it — including any ad group on the shared ad account still advertising an affected product set. Show that to the user, get an explicit yes, then call again with confirm:true. The result is checked by reading the object back (Reddit then answers 404).

adAccountId.description: Reddit ad account id (a2_...); omit when only one is shared

confirm.description: true only after the user approved the listed impact

id.description: id of the catalog, feed or product set to delete

kind.description: catalog, feed or product_set: which type the id refers to
